policies.title: Return policy
policies.excerpt: Unused orders qualify for a return through calendar day 30 after delivery, inclusive. A refund requires a recorded receipt of the return. Day 31 is outside the window. Escalate used items for review.

policies.title: Damage policy
policies.excerpt: Within 14 days after delivery, a damaged line with a completed damage declaration can receive a replacement or a refund up to its net paid amount. Apply one remedy per eligible amount or unit.

policies.title: Delay policy
policies.excerpt: At least seven calendar days after the promised date, draft a status update using verified facts. Check the original shipment before proposing a replacement. An unknown status gives no new delivery date. A shipment change invalidates a conflicting proposal.

policies.title: Refund accounting
policies.excerpt: At both order and line level, subtract verified prior refunds and pending reservations from the settled paid amount. Pending and uncertain operations reserve their amounts. A refund requires eligibility, settlement and reviewer approval.

policies.title: Evidence applicability
policies.excerpt: Use current approved policies that match the product and region. Missing or conflicting evidence requires escalation. A confidence estimate cannot override an eligibility check.
